newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indorayon says posts nine-mth net loss.
newsitem.headline: Indorayon says posts nine-mth net loss.

text.p: Nine months to September 30
(in billion rupiah unless stated)
Net profit loss 10.66 vs 123.40
Earnings per share (rph) loss 25 vs 292
Net sales 263.41 vs 484.28
Gross profit 48.33 vs 215.10
Operating profit 5.68 vs 172.86
Pre-tax profit loss 10.66 vs 123.40
Retained earnings 270.80 vs 303.57
Note: The consolidated results were unaudited. PT Inti Indorayon Utama is enagaged in the production of both soft and hardwood paper pulp. It also manufactures viscose rayon fibre.

Indorayon said it posted a net profit of 8.04 billion rupiah in the third quarter on sales of 103.6 billion rupiah, compared with a loss of 2.7 billion rupiah in the second quarter on sales of 91.3 billion rupiah.

The firm said the improvement was due to higher prices and sales volume of paper pulp. The average pulp sale price rose to $443 per tonne in the third quarter from $394 per tonne in the second quarter, which was the cyclical low for the product.
It said the average rayon price was $1,701 per tonne in the third quarter against $1,704 per tonne in the second quarter.
Indorayon said lower sales in the nine-month period were due to a lower realised average price and pulp sales volume.
It said the average paper pulp price in the first nine months was $431 per tonne against $821 in the same 1995 period. Its pulp output fell to 101,971 tonnes from 157,518 tonnes.
It said the average rayon fiber price was $1,736 per tonne in the first nine months of this year, compared with $2,143 per tonne in the same 1995 period.
It said rayon fiber production in the 1996 period rose to 40,988 tonnes from 39,274 tonnes in the same 1995 period.
Indorayon said pulp prices had improved over the past five months, recovering by about $100 per tonne from March.
It said rayon price had stabilised to around $1,700 per tonne in the domestic market.
